title: Speech, Thought, Caption & Comic SFX Text
objective: Implement speech balloons, thought balloons, captions, narration boxes and stylized comic sound-effect text while retaining readable content as actual text state and preserving SAA composition/owner boundaries.
acceptance: Speech balloons, thought balloons, captions, narration boxes and comic SFX text each retain readable authored content as actual text state rather than raster-only pixels.
Text elements preserve stable SAA identity, text content, semantic text role and presentation styling separately so styling never destroys readable text.
Balloon/caption/SFX geometry and placement bind into sealed SAA composition state without rewriting panel identity, panel reading order or source-domain truth.
Text layout and overflow state are explicit and fail closed when content cannot fit rather than silently dropping or truncating authored text.
Keyboard/textual equivalents can create, edit, inspect and position every blocking text element without requiring drag gestures.
Provider-off local operation works for authored text and local typography/layout resources; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-10 and later lettering/export/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-09 owns sequential-art text presentation state only; it does not mutate Dialogue/Narrative/Character/Scene/source-domain truth.
Readable authored text remains text and may not be replaced by raster-only representation as the canonical SAA state.
No automatic semantic rewriting, speech generation, translation, export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
SAA-10 remains blocked until verified SAA-09 closeout.
next_action: SAA-09 is completed_verified. SAA-10 — Bubble Tails, Actor Anchoring & Readability Assistance — is selected_not_started without implementation authority.
